messages:
maya: FYI discovered advisory for CVE-2026-12211 affecting musl's getaddrinfo - causes stack overflow on certain lookups in alpine:3.18-arm64.

sec-bot: [automated] New CVE detected matching our images: CVE-2026-12211 - severity: high - affected tags: alpine:3.18, alpine:3.19-edge

sahil: Which services use those base images? run/runtime sidecars? priority?

maya: runtime images (inference-runtime, dispatcher-sidecar) + build agents on arm64. Impact to production inference is possible -> marking P1 for runtime.

alex: Agreed P1 for runtime. Plan: rebuild alpine base with musl patch or pin to patched snapshot; run cross-arch CI + canary promote to dedicated pool only.

taylor: Noted a flaky test in staging when we pin musl patch last time - locale-related c-stdlib behavior. Add a quick smoke: `curl -sS http://localhost:8080/health && /usr/bin/ldd --version` to canary tests.

ryan: For signing: we'll need new KMS key binding for image-signer role. Proposal: create service account `infra-image-signer@redwood-prod` with kms.signBlob and iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob, restrict to image-signing project. Also add audit logging for `cloudkms.*` and `containeranalysis.notes.*`.

leah: Adding RBAC checklist: 1) create signer SA 2) create IAM role `roles/imageSigner` with least privilege 3) add repo CI principal to role (only for push) 4) enable auditlog sink to sec-audit project.

maya: Rollout plan draft:
```
1) build multiarch canary: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t registry.redwood/inference/runtime:canary-muslfix --push .
2) deploy to 1% canary pool (dedicated GPU pool) for 2h
3) run smoke + perf checks (latency, mem)
4) if ok, 10% for 3h, then 100%
```

alex: Who's owner for the rebuild run?

maya: I'll own build + canary. @ryan please own signer/KMS changes. @leah please own RBAC and audit sinks. I'll open PRs for the Dockerfiles and canary manifest.

sahil: Add Slack alert channel and Pager duty if canary fails latency > 5%.

taylor: Will add CI job for musl-compat smoke and update the flaky test to be more deterministic.

sec-bot: [automated] Ticket created: SEC-2026-4781 - baseimage rebuild + signer RBAC - assignees: maya, ryan, leah

maya: Thanks all, will post PR links in this thread.
